problem: A new public AI ecosystem page added 126 translatable strings after the immutable English cache snapshot, causing fail-closed production validation to block deployment.
root_cause: Public-copy delivery and immutable static-English cache ownership were not atomic. The production policy correctly disabled provider networking, so new public copy must carry its English cache delta in the same delivery lineage.
prevention: Any new or changed public translatable copy must update config/bg-static-i18n-en.json or config/bg-static-i18n-en.d in the same candidate.
STATIC_I18N_NETWORK remains 0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE remains 1 for production.
Retired .cache translation authority must never be restored.
Offline --validate-cache is required before protected merge for public-copy changes.
Provider-dependent regressions must follow the immutable offline cache contract and may not force networking back into production.
Promotion and cache-recovery candidates must also reconcile stale cross-domain regressions that still assert retired public copy; tests may not force canonical pricing context backward.
Pricing context regression must assert 'Wat wil je bereiken?' and 'Ondernemersdoelen', never the retired single-goal label 'Belangrijkste doel nu'.
